hook: Every new labor rule in 2026 hides inside the Thomson Reuters tracker.

sections.voiceover: Every new labor rule in 2026 hides inside the Thomson Reuters tracker.

Thomson Reuters published the 2026 Labor and Employment Law Developments Tracker as a Practice Note. Federal and state court decisions drive this administrative guidance. Where does traditional labor law go?
Traditional labor law and immigration law are tracked in separate resources.
Thomson Reuters released the Guide to Employment Law and Regulation in September 2026. This second edition covers civil rights immunity issues. Section 1983 actions define the updated scope.
The 2026 tracker logs every official regulatory development.
